description: This file defines the interface (function declarations and macros) for the main execution loop of the bulk data collection thread in the software project. It includes API functions for initialization, posting reports, thread execution, and scheduling exit, along with definitions of specific flags used in those functions.

methods.name: BDC_EXEC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the bulk data collection execution environment.

methods.name: BDC_EXEC_PostReportToSend
methods.description: Posts a report to the BDC server with specified parameters such as profile ID, URL, query string, authentication details, report data, and flags indicating transmission options.

methods.name: BDC_EXEC_Main
methods.description: Main thread function for executing the bulk data collection loop.

methods.name: BDC_EXEC_ScheduleExit
methods.description: Schedules the termination of the bulk data collection thread.
